decisions.reason: This collaborative robot loading system fits the firm's existing automation, machinery, software, and service capabilities well, so under absorptive capacity it is a learnable adjacent product, though as a newer robotics offer it still carries some early-market risk.
The dual-table loading system is a close extension of the firm's core machining and automation know-how, making it easy to support, refine, and commercialize within a growing firm and industry.

The industrial dispensing machine is explicitly presented as a strategic focus and already shows positive market validation through a design award, so it is highly likely to be retained and further developed using the firm's strong related knowledge base.
